description: This 3D model showcases two cylindrical ottomans. The ottoman on the left is a solid white with a textured surface, resembling a pebbled leather or a similar synthetic material. It has a smooth, rounded shape that tapers slightly towards the top. The ottoman on the right features a distinct striped pattern of alternating wide bands of light beige or off-white and a medium grey. The fabric appears to have a visible weave, suggesting a natural material like linen or cotton. Both ottomans have a small black tag or handle extending from the top rim.
